temaNombre: Spanish Accent Marks: Agudas, Llanas and Esdrújulas
title: The Mystery of Spanish Accent Marks
summary: Classify Spanish words by their stressed syllable and practise their basic accent-mark rules.
keyIdeas: The stressed syllable is the syllable we say most strongly in a word.
In the examples here, agudas take an accent mark when ending in a vowel, -n or -s; llanas take one when ending in another consonant.
Esdrújulas are stressed on the third-to-last syllable and always take an accent mark.

basicKnowledge: D. Reflexión sobre la lengua y sus usos en el marco de propuestas de producción y comprensión de textos orales, escritos o multimodales

activities.explanation: The last syllable, «-ón», is stressed. This makes «camaleón» an aguda.
activities.hint: Say the word slowly and clap on the strongest syllable.

activities.prompt: All Spanish esdrújulas take an accent mark.
activities.explanation: True. Esdrújulas always have an accent mark on their stressed syllable.

activities.prompt: Match each Spanish word type with the position of its stressed syllable.
activities.explanation: Agudas are stressed on the last syllable, llanas on the second-to-last and esdrújulas on the third-to-last.

activities.prompt: Sort these Spanish words by the position of their stressed syllable.
activities.explanation: «Tambor» and «compás» are agudas; «mochila» and «árbol» are llanas; «brújula» and «lámpara» are esdrújulas.

activities.prompt: Choose the correctly spelt Spanish word to complete the sentence.
activities.explanation: «Pincel» is an aguda ending in «l», so it does not take an accent mark.
activities.sentence: Aisha metió el ___ en la mochila antes de ir a clase de Plástica.

activities.prompt: Hugo and Martina read this library notice: «El club de lectura es muy util». Which word has an accent-mark error?
activities.explanation: «Útil» is a llana ending in «l», so it needs an accent mark on «u».
activities.hint: Look for a llana ending in a consonant other than -n or -s.

activities.prompt: Put the steps for deciding whether a Spanish word needs an accent mark in order.
activities.explanation: Find the stressed syllable, classify the word, check its ending and apply the rule.
items: Say the word and find its stressed syllable.
Decide whether it is an aguda, llana or esdrújula.
Check the letter at the end of the word.
Apply the spelling rule and add an accent mark if needed.

activities.prompt: Why does «azúcar» take an accent mark while «cuchara» does not, although both are llanas?
activities.explanation: For these llanas, the ending decides the rule: «azúcar» ends in «r», whereas «cuchara» ends in a vowel.
options: Because «cuchara» has more syllables than «azúcar» and does not need an accent mark.
Because words starting with «a» always need an accent mark.
Because «azúcar» ends in a consonant other than -n or -s, while «cuchara» ends in a vowel.

activities.prompt: Read the Spanish school news and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: The text includes agudas with accent marks, such as «calabacín» and «ilusión», and esdrújulas, such as «ecológico» and «automático».
activities.title: Gran éxito del huerto escolar
activities.text: El alumnado de cuarto de primaria inauguró ayer el nuevo huerto ecológico del colegio. Durante semanas, niños y niñas plantaron semillas de calabacín, tomate y perejil con gran ilusión. Omar y Nerea explicaron a las familias cómo funciona el sistema de riego automático que construyeron con tubos reciclados. Además, colocaron pequeños carteles de madera para identificar cada hortaliza. La directora del centro felicitó a toda la clase por su esfuerzo, dedicación y trabajo en equipo. ¡Pronto recogerán su primera cosecha!

questions.prompt: Which word from the text is an aguda with an accent mark?
questions.explanation: «Calabacín» is stressed on the last syllable and takes an accent mark because it ends in «n».

questions.prompt: Which word from the text is an esdrújula?
questions.explanation: «Ecológico» is stressed on the third-to-last syllable: «e-co-ló-gi-co».

activities.prompt: Lucía checks this packing list for a trip: «melocoton, lapiz, cantimplora y platano». How many words need an accent mark?
activities.explanation: «Melocotón» is an aguda ending in -n; «lápiz» is a llana ending in -z; «plátano» is an esdrújula. «Cantimplora» is a llana ending in a vowel and needs no accent mark.
activities.hint: Look for an aguda, a llana ending in «z» and an esdrújula.
options: 4 words: every word in the list
